name: screenpipe
description: Search your screen recordings and audio transcriptions with AI
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to Screenpipe running on this computer. Search recordings and audio, retrieve meeting notes, and use the tools exposed by your local Screenpipe server. Requested results are shared with Claude. This local extension does not require Data Sync.

tools.name: search-content
tools.description: Search recorded screen content, audio, memories, and parsed app data through one filtering surface

tools.name: export-video
tools.description: Export screen recordings as an MP4 for a time range — with synced audio by default (pass fps for a silent timelapse)

tools.name: list-meetings
tools.description: List detected meetings with id, duration, app, attendees, and note; q searches all history

tools.name: activity-summary
tools.description: Lightweight compressed activity overview for a time range (apps, recent texts, audio summary)

tools.name: search-elements
tools.description: Search structured UI elements (accessibility tree nodes and OCR text blocks)

tools.name: frame-context
tools.description: Get accessibility text, parsed tree nodes, and extracted URLs for a specific frame

api_url.title: Screenpipe API URL
api_url.description: Local Screenpipe API address. Keep the default unless you changed its port.

api_key.title: Local API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave blank to discover it through the Screenpipe CLI. If authentication fails, use the key returned by screenpipe auth token.
